title: Microsoft Teams: Simplified Teams app bar to create a cleaner and more focused experience.
description: We’ve simplified the app bar to help you focus on what matters. Apps are easier to scan in a cleaner View more apps list, the overflow menu is less cluttered, and you can choose to show or hide the app bar to create more space for your work.
